However, the watchman informed me that membership is strictly hereditary, intended only for blood relatives. He also stated that no new memberships have been granted since 1995.
​This situation is truly disgusting because they fail to mention this restriction online. I assume that countless people must have visited over the years, only to leave disappointed. This current owner/s' mentality is extremely poor—it's a form of harassment for non-members, perhaps seeking publicity or some perverse pleasure.

Dear Team  - YMCA Procter Branch Mumbai,

Today was the final day of my two-month training, and I could not let it pass without thanking the entire team.
I would like to extend my heartfelt gratitude to the entire team of YMCA Procter Branch Swimming Training Branch for providing such an excellent training experience over the last two months.

A very special thanks to Amul Raj Sir, Sebastian Paul Sir ,Peter Sir, Rashid Sir, Sadique Sir, Ashim Sir, Mr. Ali, Mr. Huzefa, and also to the Office Staff, caretakers, reception(Mr. Patil & Mr. Sudhir ) & housekeeping staff.

Each one of them has contributed immensely—not just in teaching swimming techniques but also in creating an environment where beginners like me felt comfortable, confident, and motivated.

However, the coaches handled my case with utmost care, calmly guiding me through my skill gaps, correcting me on every dive, and advising me with patience.

While I have gained significant knowledge and comfort in swimming to the best of my physical ability, I am now motivated to further enhance my skills and continue this journey with YMCA Procter branch.

I must also mention that the pool facilities are maintained exceptionally well—clean, hygienic, and welcoming round the clock—which adds to the overall positive experience.

I would be delighted to continue my swimming journey with the YMCA Procter branch and further enhance my skills, progressing at a pace that aligns with my personal fitness and well-being.

Thank you once again to the entire YMCA Procter family for your dedication and warmth. I look forward to being part of your sessions again soon.

Warm regards,
Aamir

featured_reviews.review_text:
Title: A Refreshing Oasis in the Heart of Mumbai

As a resident of Mahim, I've been frequenting the Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool for many years, and I've always been impressed by its facilities and the overall swimming experience it offers. While there's always room for improvement, I believe the pool deserves a solid 4-star rating, reflecting its strengths and acknowledging the areas where it could enhance its offerings.

Cleanliness and Maintenance:

The pool complex is generally well-maintained, with clean and hygienic pools, changing rooms, and shower areas. The staff regularly checks the water quality, ensuring it meets the necessary standards. While there have been instances of minor cleanliness issues, they've been promptly addressed by the staff.

Facilities and Amenities:

The pool complex boasts a variety of amenities catering to swimmers of all ages and skill levels. The main pool, an Olympic-sized one, is ideal for lap swimming and training. The separate diving pool is perfect for practicing dives and aquatic stunts. Additionally, there's a smaller pool for kids, providing a safe and fun environment for them to learn and enjoy the water.

Pool Staff and Safety:

The pool staff is generally helpful and attentive, ensuring the safety of swimmers at all times. Experienced lifeguards are stationed around the pools, keeping a watchful eye on everyone. The pool also has clear signage and safety guidelines in place to minimize the risk of accidents.

Overall Experience:

Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool is a great place to come for a refreshing swim, whether you're looking for a leisurely workout or a fun family outing. The pool's facilities are well-maintained, the staff is friendly and helpful, and the safety measures are commendable. While there's always room for improvement, the pool consistently delivers a positive swimming experience, earning it a solid 4-star rating.

Areas for Improvement:

Parking: The pool's parking facilities can be limited during peak hours, making it challenging to find a spot. Expanding the parking area or introducing valet parking services would be beneficial.

Shower Rooms: The shower rooms could be refurbished to provide a more modern and comfortable experience. Upgrading the fixtures and adding more shower cubicles would enhance the overall experience.

Food Options: While there are a few snack and beverage options available at the canteen it closes by 9 pm and expanding the food menu to include more substantial meals would cater to swimmers who spend longer hours at the pool.

Despite these areas for improvement, Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool remains a valuable asset to the Dadar community and a popular choice for both casual swimmers and fitness enthusiasts. Its dedication to cleanliness, safety, and providing a welcoming environment makes it a rewarding place to spend a day in the water.

featured_reviews.name: Marie Rose
featured_reviews.review_text:
This review is only for those parent(s) who are from middle class background and who know basic swimming that was learnt from their parents or from a professional and who are expecting that their child would pick basic swimming in their 60 sessions of Michael Phelps at Sahar Plaza Andheri East.

I would not recommend this place and instead if you have a pool within your society take your kid there and teach swimming as it is not rocket science but only practice. I enrolled my six year old daughter on 05/11/2025 with expiry on July 5, 2026 for 60 sessions as you can see from the swimming card. I was told that first 12 sessions was making the kid comfortable in water, gliding in water and jumping into water without fear which my daughter did. In reality, she was doing this for 15 sessions till I took them to task and asked them when they would start teaching her swimming that only then did they began her swimming classes. My kid was happy in the pool and was picking swimming quite well with confidence till 18th March on the 28th session when the head coach asked me about renewal as there was an offer going on. I told the coach that my expiry was not due and I will do it at that time irrespective of the offer. After that on the 29th session, the instructor who was teaching my kid started behaving oddly with my kid. He would instead of focussing on her swimming, started holding her when she was swimming or when she was jumping in water. Suddenly, in that one day, my daughter told me that if she didn’t swim properly, she would drown. The next session, I again noticed the same behaviour in the instructor and I realized that the instructor was hitting the confidence of my daughter by holding her hand when she jumped in the water which was never done with her. That was the last session of my daughter with Michael Phelps and on that day I gave earful to the head coach and questioned how the instructor had undermined the confidence of my kid. I told the head coach that till date the instructor never held the hand of my daughter whenever she jumped into the water and why did he hold only her hand and not the hand of any other kids who had jumped in the water. On hindsight, I realized that since I did not commit a renewal when asked to do so, the coaches decided to slow the progress of learning swimming of my kid so that I would do another 60 sessions and what is worse is for greed of money they hit the confidence of my kid in water by instilling fear of drowning so much so that it took me another 8 sessions in the pool of my society to rectify this fear. I decided to forgo the remaining 30 sessions of my daughter as I don’t want to entrust her with teachers who instilled fear instead of positive learning and it takes a long time to unlearn that instilled fear.
Coming to my background, I learnt swimming from my mother in a local pond in 10 days and so did my husband. After that, I sharpened my swimming with breathing technique in 15 days by a trainer. All my instructors be it my mother or the trainer told me only one thing – Be free in water and water will always push you upwards and the moment you struggle you will sink, so just be free in water and feel the water. This was a positive learning that I got about swimming. This learning takes time but it is positive learning and helps in swimming. The moment you talk to a child about drowning, the child learns fear not swimming.

So for those parents who think that their kid will learn swimming here in 60 sessions, its not going to happen without a renewal at Michael Phelps. The techniques taught here are all good but when a kid’s confidence is hit, it is difficult. If you have the money, then honey Michael Phelps is for you.

featured_reviews.name: Sahaj shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am sharing this review to give honest feedback about this swimming centre.

The teachers and reception staff are generally helpful and sincere. One teacher noticed that my child was losing confidence and adjusted the training, which we really appreciated.

However, there are some areas where improvement is needed, especially since many young children attend these classes.

1. Cold Weather Conditions
Since this is an outdoor pool, strong winds blow directly onto the students during monsoon and winter. It feels cold even for parents sitting outside, and it is difficult for children after they come out of the water. When we raised this concern, we did not receive clear solutions.

2. Temperature-Regulated Pool
The pool is said to be temperature regulated, which is one reason we enrolled. However, during winter we were told that the heater was not working and would be started later. The water remained quite cold, making it difficult for children to complete their sessions comfortably.

3. Communication
Most staff members are polite, but one or two people sometimes speak in a way that feels a bit rude. A more friendly tone would help parents feel more comfortable.

4. Pool Support
There are no support rods or bars along the pool walls for children to hold. These would be helpful for beginners.

5. Washroom Facilities
Many mothers come with young children, but there is only one shower in the female washroom. Because of this, some people have to leave without washing after swimming.

Overall, the teachers are good, but some improvements in facilities and planning would make the experience much better for children and parents.

Positives:

Temperature-Controlled Pool – A big advantage, especially during rains and winter.
9-Foot Depth – Ideal for learning diving and improving treading water skills.
6-Day Availability – Open six days a week, making it easy to choose batches as per convenience.
Coaches – Highly professional, patient, courteous, dedicated, and knowledgeable.
All Swimming Strokes – Comprehensive training covering freestyle, breaststroke, backstroke, and butterfly.
Patient Learning Approach – Coaches ensure everyone learns at their own pace with proper attention.
Supportive Staff – Mouzam, Sakshi, and the entire administrative team are extremely helpful and cooperative.
All Age Groups Welcome – From kids as young as 5 to adults over 75, proving age is never a barrier.

My Journey:

I already knew breaststroke, but I always wanted to learn the other swimming styles. Like many, I never really found the time or push to start. When my wife joined the Michael Phelps Swimming program at Willingdon Sports Club, I would accompany her. One day, Mouzam encouraged me to join as well.

Initially, I was unsure—did I really need to learn new strokes? But I eventually decided to take the plunge, both literally and figuratively.

Starting out wasn’t easy. Learning new strokes felt challenging, but beginner coach Mahesh Sir played a key role in helping me pick up freestyle and backstroke. As I progressed, advanced coach Prayag Sir helped refine my breaststroke—I realized how much energy I had been wasting due to incorrect technique. He also guided me through learning butterfly, which is by far the most challenging stroke. Along the way, he fine-tuned all my strokes, especially backstroke and breaststroke.

Both coaches offered exceptional guidance, focusing on technique, form correction, drills, and personalized attention.

A special mention to Sameer Sir as well—though I had limited sessions with him, his professionalism and dedication stood out.

Even with prior knowledge of basic swimming, it took me nearly a year to confidently learn all strokes. The coaches and staff are incredibly friendly and always ready to help with any concerns.

A big thank you to Mahesh Sir, Prayag Sir, and Mouzam for their consistent support and dedication.

Final Thought:
The facility and coaching are excellent—but consistency is the key to truly learning and improving in swimming.

featured_reviews.name: Irfan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined the swimming program at Michael Phelps Swimming India, Kohinoor Club Kurla, expecting a professional and hygienic environment, but unfortunately my experience was disappointing.

The biggest concern is cleanliness and hygiene. The washroom areas are not maintained properly and often feel unhygienic. The pool maintenance also needs serious improvement. Additionally, there is no proper shade or sun protection around the pool area, making it uncomfortable during peak daytime sessions.

Another issue is the lack of proper team management and professionalism among some staff members. There seems to be poor coordination between coaches, and arguments or conflicts happening in front of students create an uncomfortable environment. Some coaches also appear uninterested and non-cooperative during sessions, which affects the overall learning experience.

There were also occasions where staff members appeared to consume tobacco products before or during sessions, which created an unpleasant environment due to strong odor and felt highly unprofessional around students and parents.

Communication is another challenge due to language barriers, and overall the atmosphere feels poorly managed for a place that represents such a reputed name.

I hope the management takes these concerns seriously and improves the hygiene, professionalism, discipline, and overall experience for students and parents.
